events.description: A space to pause, reflect, and explore what the Quran has to say about finding direction when life feels uncertain.

events.speaker: Mariyam Qurayshi
events.description: An honest first gathering on direction, return, and hope.
events.recap: This first Suhbah explored how the Quran changes the way we think, respond, and see ourselves. The conversation centered on letting Quranic guidance move beyond recitation into daily choices, character, and a more honest relationship with Allah.

events.speaker: Mariyam Qurayshi
events.description: A conversation about belonging, identity, and the Quranic lens.
events.recap: This session reflected on companionship through the story of the People of the Cave. We spoke about the people we keep close, the spaces that protect our faith, and how sincere company can help us stay grounded when the world pulls elsewhere.

testimonials.quote: I came expecting a talk. I left with questions I actually wanted to think about.
testimonials.name: Suhbah attendee

testimonials.quote: Suhbah made the Quran feel much more relevant to the things I was going through.
testimonials.name: Community member

testimonials.quote: It was refreshing to sit with other young people and have honest conversations about faith.
testimonials.name: Monthly participant
